units.source_text: 真的，要是好好想一想，几时会有逃脱机会，怎样到来，看来简直是没希望了。

en.t: Really, if he thought it through carefully, when a chance to escape might come and how it might arrive seemed utterly hopeless.

units.source_text: 他已经习惯于茫无目的的等待，就这样，终于连蛰居的冬季也眼看着要结束了，

en.t: He had already grown used to waiting without any clear purpose, and in this way even the shut-in winter was finally about to come to an end before his eyes,

units.source_text: 刺眼的光线将会弄得他无法外出，这些他都充分考虑到了。

en.t: and he had fully taken into account that the dazzling light would soon make it impossible for him to go outside.

units.source_text: 俗话说，做三天叫花子，就再也舍不得不干了……

en.t: As the saying goes, after three days as a beggar, one can no longer bear to give it up...

units.source_text: 这种内部开始的腐蚀，意外地来得很快……

en.t: This kind of corrosion that begins from within came unexpectedly quickly...

units.source_text: 就这样钻进牛角尖，忽然想起那张马脸，忍不住又被傻呵呵的笑给缠住了。

en.t: As he backed himself into that dead end of thought, he suddenly remembered that horse-like face, and despite himself was once again caught up in a foolish grin.

units.source_text: 坐在灯下，仍然一心一意穿珠子的女人，仰起脸，茫然地回给他一个天真的笑。

en.t: The woman sitting under the lamp, still single-mindedly stringing beads, lifted her face and blankly returned him an innocent smile.

units.source_text: 男人觉得受不了自我背叛，于是，他丢下漫画，跑到了外面。

en.t: The man felt he could not endure this betrayal of himself, so he dropped the comic and ran outside.
